Commentary.Commentary: Pakistan will feel slightly hard done, if they even can. The wicket didn't really have much to offer so they had to toil extremely hard to bowl the Lankans out. Hasan Ali, Mohammad Abbas, Yasir Shah and Haris Sohail all shared the spoils, with Abbas cleaning the tail up to get his team in to bat. Sri Lanka might have to put in a similar effort on the field, but if the signs are to be believed, as we saw earlier that the cracks are opening, Rangana Herath would already be raring to have a go at the hosts. Remains to be seen how Pakistan approach the remainder of the day. Don't go anywhere, it'll begin shortly...

Sri Lanka have a superb first innings total on the board, courtesy a massive ton via their skipper Dinesh Chandimal. He was a part of all three crucial stands, which have led Sri Lanka past the 400-run mark. First with Karunaratne, who was unfortunate to miss out on his century. Then Dickwella, who shared a similar fate to the opener. And then with Perera, who played a handy knock. The tail got cleaned up quickly but the job was done by that point.

OUT!  SRI LANKA HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 419! Abbas gets two in two and he will be on a hat-trick in the next innings. He bowls it fuller in length on off, swinging back in. Pradeep goes for an expansive drive but leaves a big gap between bat and pad. The ball sneaks through and hits the timber. Pradeep bags a golden duck. Abbas gets his third.
Nuwan Pradeep is the last man in.

OUT! This time he gets one but it is Sandakan and not Chandimal. Abbas bowls it fuller on middle, swinging in. Sandakan tries to flick but misses and the ball strikes his pads. The Pakistan players appeal and the umpire straightaway raises his finger. Lakshan could consider himself a touch unlucky, it was missing leg maybe.
Angles it into the pads, Chandimal flicks it through square leg for a run.
Works it with the swing to mid-wicket.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

OUT! Oh no wait, it is a no ball! Abbas cannot believe it. He bowls a full inswinger on middle, Chandimal comes down the track and tries to go big but misses and the ball hits the middle stump but the umpire signals no ball. Abbas has overstepped. Sarfraz is not a happy man. Chandimal might argue that he had heard the call.
A long-hop by Shah on off stump. Lakshan swivels and tries to pull it but only manages to get an inside edge onto his pads. He tries hitting that too hard maybe.
Gives it air this time and lands it on off, Sandakan lunges forward in defense but gets beaten.
Flatter on off, Sandakan defends it solidly.
Tosses it up on leg stump, Chandimal drives it down to long on for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Drags his length back on off, Chandimal waits for it and pushes it to the man at covers.
Yasir Shah is back into the attack.
FOUR! He overcompensates. Angles this one down the leg side. Sandakan just had to get bat to it and he does so. The ball races down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.

FOUR! Boundary to get off the mark, not convincing but Sandakan won't mind. Abbas bowls it full outside off, Lakshan tries to drive but gets an outside edge which goes down to the third man fence. Sarfraz is not happy as he wanted Abbas to bowl a bit straighter.
Lakshan Sandakan strides out to the middle.

OUT! That is plumb! Abbas gets his first of the match. That swung in a long way. Mohammad bowls it fuller in length outside off, it shapes back in. Lakmal who tries to drive it straight misses and is struck on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger as he has no doubts. An early wicket after the break, something that Pakistan needed.
Errs in line and drifts it on the pads, Chandimal with ease flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Fuller in length on middle, Chandimal drives it to mid on.
He comes running in and bowls it from wide of the crease. He angles it into the pads. Chandimal flicks it to mid-wicket.
Mohammad Abbas will bowl from the other end.
Shorter in length outside off, Lakmal goes on the back foot and has all the time in the world to cut it hard through covers for a couple.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
An arm ball on the pads, skids off the surface. Lakmal looks  to flick but misses and is struck on the pads.
Comes down the track and drives it through mid off for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Chandimal defends it towards point.
Drags his length back outside off, Lakmal cuts it through covers for a run.

We are back for the final session of the day. It will be for only one and a half hours, not two, to adjust for the longer opening session. Dinesh Chandimal and Suranga Lakmal walk out. Haris Sohail to take the ball. There's a slip in place. Here we go...
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

This session - 28 overs, 81 runs and two wickets. Sri Lanka are heading into a position from where it will be difficult for them to lose. Once again it has been the away side's session thanks to Chandimal. He has stood there like a wall and got good support from the rest. Now the visitors would look to add quick runs and it would be interesting to see when they declare, if at all they do. Pakistan on the other hand, would want to come out and not let the tourists score freely and keep the runs down. Join us in a while for the third session.
Googly on middle, Chandimal reads it and flicks it to mid-wicket. TEA ON DAY 2!
Flatter on the stumps, Dinesh goes on the back foot and defends it.
Floats it on off, Chandimal lunges forward and blocks it.
Tosses it up on middle, Chandimal defends it off the front foot.

150 up for Dinesh Chandimal! He's played a superb knock, though he would have liked to reached the milestone in a less risky manner. Picks his spot nicely, but not sure he should be playing that shot as this is the last over before tea. Yasir tosses it up on leg stump. Chandimal tries to go over mid-wicket but mistimes it and it falls in no man's land for a couple.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Darts it on the leg stump, Lakmal goes to defend but is struck low on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tosses it up outside off, Chandimal drives it through mid off for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Lakmal cuts it through point for three.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fires it on the stumps. Lakmal defends it solidly.
Works it around the corner, against the spin for a run.
Quicker on the stumps, Lakmal camps back and defends it.
Flatter on off, Lakmal defends it off the back foot.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
Suranga Lakmal comes out to bat.

OUT! There was an edge!  Yasir Shah strikes! The bowling change has done the trick. He tosses it up outside off, turning back in. Herath goes for the reverse sweep but the ball bounces a touch more and lobs off something to Azam at leg slip who pouches it easily and appeals. The umpire after thinking raises his finger. Herath straightaway reviews. Replays show that there is a spike on Ultra Edge as it passes the bat. The third umpire asks the on-field umpire to stay with his decision. Rangana Herath is not happy as he walks back to the hut. Sri Lanka are seven down now.
Herath has been given out caught but he reviews it immediately. He seems very confident about it.
Tosses it up on middle, Chandimal drives it towards mid on for a run.
Yasir Shah is back into the attack.
Drives it through mid on for a run.

Masood has been impressive in the field. Chandimal comes down the track and gets to the pitch of the ball, he drives it towards mid off. Masood at covers runs to his right and dives to stop the ball. He also fires in a throw at the striker's end which almost hits Chandimal. Good aggression by the young man.
Flighted ball outside the off stump, Herath taps it towards point and takes a quick run.
Floats it outside off, turning back in. Herath defends it off the front foot.
Straightaway he is on the attack. Brings out the reverse sweep through short third man for a couple.
Works it against the spin towards mid-wicket for a run.
A full toss on leg stump, Herath defends it towards mid on.
Bowls a yorker on middle, Herath does well to dig it out.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the pads. Chandimal misses the flick and the ball brushes the pads and rolls towards fine leg for a leg bye.
Good length on off, Chandimal on the up drives it to mid off.
Fuller in length on off, Chandimal drives it to mid off.
Back of a length on off, Herath defends it towards covers for a run.
Fires it on the pads, Herath fails to flick it. The ball hits the pads and rolls on the leg side for a leg bye.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floats it up on off, Herath defends it off the front foot.
Rangana Herath is the next man in.

OUT! Richard Kettleborough is a happy man this time as his decision stands. This is also Haris Sohail's maiden Test wicket. Dilruwan after two successful reviews has to finally walk back now after an unsuccessful one. Sohail tosses it up on middle, Perera in the pursuit of quick runs goes for a slog over the leg side but misses and is struck on the pads. The Pakistan players make a huge appeal and the umpire raises his finger. After a chat with his skipper at the other end, Perera decides to review. Replays show that there are three reds. Perera is walking back after playing a dogged knock. The 92-run stand has been broken. Pakistan would now want to clean the tail up as quick as possible.
Third time lucky with the review? Dilruwan has been given out LBW and he has reviewed. It looks out to the naked eye.
Shorter in length on off, Dinesh cuts it through covers for a run.
Slower through the air on off, Chandimal defends it off the front foot.
Fuller in length on off, Perera drives it to mid off.
A low full toss outside off, Perera drives it towards cover-point where Masood dives full length to his right and makes a great stop.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length on off, Perera defends it off the back foot.
Bangs in a short one on middle. Perera ducks under it.
Lands it on a length on off, Perera defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it up outside off, Perera drives it through covers for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Shorter and quicker outside off. Perera goes for the cut but gets beaten.

NOT OUT! Dilruwan's luck continues. He steps down the track to go big once again. Sohail seeing that fires it wide outside off. Perera misses and Sarfraz behind the stumps collects the ball and does well to quickly take the bails off and appeals. The umpire goes upstairs. Replays show that Perera had just grounded his bat in time. After a few replays the third umpire presses the not out button. Sarfraz did well there as he had to collect the ball from really wide of off and then take the bails off, that is what saved Dilruwan.
They have gone upstairs to check for a stumping against Dilruwan Perera. Looks very close!

SIX! BANG! We saw him doing this against India and now against Pakistan. Perera sees the flighted ball on leg stump, comes down the track and lofts it over the long on fence for a maximum. Top shot that.
Fetches the ball from outside leg stump and nails the reverse sweep, down to deep backward point for a run.
Superb yorker from Mohammad Amir. Fires it in on middle stump, Perera is equally up for it though as he digs it out on the off side. Good over from Amir, he's never short on effort.
Bumper on middle and leg, Perera reads the length early and hence, has no trouble to duck underneath it.
Worked away comfortably on the leg side for an easy run.

Play and a miss! Slightly risky shot to play given the uneven bounce and the fact that we've witnessed a couple of drag ons before. Keeping a bit low on a length around off, Chandimal looks to cut but misses.
Too straight in line, easy enough for the batsman to turn it on the leg side.
Continues from around the wicket, it's the slower one, Dinesh taps it down into the off side.
Third one in a row. No trouble for the leg before as it's pitching outside leg, but pretty sure Perera would have liked to connect the sweep this time.
The batsman has been hit on the pads as he tried to sweep that one.
Looped up around leg, Perera gets down to sweep but it goes off his pads on the off side.
Quick and a tad short, punched off the back foot.
FOUR! He's got his dancing shoes on! Perera with a hop down the ground smashes it straight back down the ground and past long on for a boundary.
Not much turn on this occasion, it's well outside off, Chandimal with a solid punch through to sweeper cover for one.
Full and straight from Amir, driven back to the bowler.
Outside off on a fullish length, pushed in front of covers for nothing.

Shouts for an lbw! Shut down, was missing the leg stump. Angling in, the line isn't ideal as it's a fraction straight. Catches Dilruwan on the pads as he misses his flick. The umpire clearly sees it's angling too far down, so he immediately tells the bowler that it's not out.
Fires it full and gets it to angle in on middle and leg, flicked away through the mid-wicket area for an easy run.
Short delivery angling down leg, simple decision for Dinesh to duck and let it sail over him.
Starts off from around the wicket and angles it in on off, Chandimal walks a step across and blocks it back down the track.
Mohammad Amir comes back into the bowling attack.
Tossed up on the stumps, easily negotiated by Dilruwan to end the over.
Half-tracker outside off, goes back and cuts it away past the cover fielder for a couple of good runs.
Darts a full delivery on off, Dilruwan brings a straight bat down to jam it out.
Uses his feet to the get to the pitch of the ball and drives it to long on for a single.
Flat and short outside off, cut straight to cover-point.
Quicker through the air on off, full in length, Chandimal drives it back to the bowler.
After a lengthy spell, Yasir Shah has been given a break. Haris Sohail will take the ball now.

Loud appeal for a leg before, turned down! Might just have been going down leg. Tailing back in on a bit of a fuller length, Perera misses his flick shot to be rapped on the pads. Hasan Ali turns and appeals, umpire Nigel Llong doesn't respond. Was close, not a bad shout.
Stays right behind the line of this one and blocks it out.

Cross seam delivery, on a length around off, Perera just checks his shot at the last second and so, the ball bobbles a bit on the off side. No harm done though, it falls well short of the point fielder.
Another one on the shorter side, another watchful duck from the batsman.
Bouncer from Hasan Ali, it's well-directed. Perera ducks and evades.
FOUR! One more! Suddenly we have a flurry of boundaries here in Abu Dhabi. Fuller in length around off, Dilruwan with a scintillating drive through extra cover finds the fence with utmost ease.

FOUR! A sudden change in approach from the Sri Lankan Test captain. Good to see, something's triggered him to switch gears. It's tossed up on middle and leg, he comes down the track and lofts it over mid off to end the over with a boundary.
FOUR! Gets better connection this time and gets the desired result. Finally! He gets low to bring the reverse sweep out again and chips it over point for a boundary.

Good, creative stuff from Dinesh Chandimal. Seeing the extra flight on the ball, he kneels down and brings out the reverse sweep. Clears the infield over cover-point but will only pick up two. Slow outfield yet again, unfortunate to miss out on a boundary.

Spinning away from around off, Dilruwan attempts to cut but gets it off the outer half. Flies past first slip as the batsmen take three. The outfield is slow, hence he was unable to fetch himself a boundary.
Down the leg side, the batsman has nothing to do with it.
Full in length and slower through the air, on middle and off, Perera with a solid front foot defensive shot.
Another inside edge, similar to how Chandimal played it earlier in the over. It's away on the leg side and a single is taken.
Opens the face slightly before tapping it down in front of cover-point.
Fuller length around the off stump line, Perera plants his front foot forward to push it into the covers.
Just ahead of a length, on off stump, Dinesh is half-forward to play but the ball takes the inside edge and goes to the leg side. One run taken.
Good length delivery very close to off, kept out simply off the back foot.
That didn't bounce as much as he expected. Hasan Ali bowls it outside off and offers some width, Chandimal has a wild slash at it but misses due to the lack of bounce on this occasion.
Single to end the over. It's flicked to the mid-wicket region to keep strike.
Floated ball around leg again, blocked well from within the crease.
Spinning a touch on leg stump, Dinesh looks to flick but it goes off the leading edge just past the slip fielder.
Presents a tight defensive shot. The Lankan skipper is forward to defend by keeping bat and pad close together.
Flighted well on middle and leg, too full in length though which allows Chandimal to flick it to mid-wicket before the ball even turns.
Yasir continues from around the wicket and loops it up outside leg, it spins as Chandimal pads it away. Easily done.
Good length on off, shaping back in. Dilruwan defends it off the front foot.
Angles it into the pads of Perera who flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Goes for the yorker but ends up serving a full toss on off. Dilruwan drives it to the man at covers.
Good length on off, Dilruwan defends it off the front foot.
Fuller in length outside off, Dilruwan drives it towards the man at mid off.
Hasan Ali comes running in and bowls it on a length around middle. Perera with relative ease defends it.
Shorter in length on leg stump. Perera flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Bowls it down the leg side. Perera pads it away.
Plays the sweep shot but straight to the short fine leg fielder.
Flatter and quicker this time on leg stump. Bounces a touch more. Dilruwan tries to defend but misses and is hit somewhere close to the box.
Similar length on leg stump. Perera lunges forward in defense.
Tosses it up on leg stump, turning away. Dilruwan defends it off the front foot.
Similar length on off, stays a touch low. Chandimal defends it off the toe end and back to the bowler.
Good length on off, Chandimal defends it off the front foot.
Fuller on middle, too easy for Chandimal. He flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Shorter in length outside off, Chandimal tries to cut but gets an inside edge onto the ground.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Angles it on middle, Chandimal flicks it to mid-wicket.
Hasan Ali is back into the attack. He is their most successful pace bowler and Pakistan would hope he could take one more.
Lands it outside leg stump, Perera pads it away.
Fuller in length but down the leg side. Perera opts not to play at it and pads it away.
Similar length ball once again, Perera plays it with his pads.
Floats it outside leg stump. Dilruwan pads it away.
Flicks it against the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Comes around the wicket and bowls it full on the pads. Chandimal works it to mid-wicket.
Length ball around off, Perera with confidence defends it towards cover.
A bouncer this time on middle. Perera does well to evade it.
A very full delivery on off, Dilruwan jams it out, back to the bowler.

WOW! That has come in a long way after pitching! It surely must have come off a crack. Abbas bowls an off cutter outside off stump, the ball comes in after pitching, surprising Chandimal who flicks it down to deep square leg for a run.
Good length outside off, nips into the batsman. Chandimal with the swing works it to mid-wicket.
Slower delivery on off, Chandimal reads it well and blocks it.
Well played Dilruwan! Yasir Shah bowls it quicker on off, gets it to bounce off the surface. Dilruwan goes on the back foot and does very well to keep it down as he plays it with soft hands.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Very full on the pads, Dinesh tucks it around the corner for a run.
Works it against the spin to mid-wicket.
A full toss on leg stump, Chandimal flicks it but straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Tosses it up outside off, inviting Chandimal to drive. He obliges but hits it straight to the man at covers.
Almost chops it on! Abbas goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. The ball jags back in sharply after pitching. Perera who tries to defend it, gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Good length on off, Perera defends it solidly.
Bowls it on middle, angling into the batsman. Chandimal flicks it towards the right of mid on for a run. Hasan Ali who has had a poor time in the field does well there.
Corrects his mistake immediately. Bowls it full on middle, Chandimal drives it to mid on.

FOUR! Easy-peasy for Chandimal! Not the line you want to be bowling to a batsman playing on 121. Abbas bowls it shorter outside off, Chandimal cuts it through point for a boundary. He really hit that hard.
Abbas goes wide of the crease and lands it on a length outside off. Chandimal drives it to covers.
Loopy ball outside off, Perera drives it to the man at covers.
A googly by Yasir Shah. Perera works it to mid-wicket.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Tosses it up on off, Perera covers the line of the ball and defends it.
Shorter in length on off, Perera plays it towards point.
Floats it up outside off, Dinesh leans into it and drives it past the diving cover fielder who half stops it but cannot stop a single.
Length ball outside off, Perera drives it to the cover fielder.
Good length on off, Perera defends it off the front foot.
Shorter in length outside off, Perera looks to cut but is beaten by the lack of bounce.
Angles it into the pads of Chandimal. He is too good a player to miss out. He flicks it through mid-wicket for three.
A touch fuller in length on off, Chandimal on the up drives it but straight to the man at covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller in length on leg stump, Chandimal drives it down to long on for a run.
Works it towards point for a run.
Short and wide again by Yasir. Dilruwan goes for the cut but the ball gets big on him, it takes the outside edge and through short third man for a couple.
Shorter in length outside off, Chandimal cuts it through the off side for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Yasir Shah is getting some bounce now! He bowls it outside off, on a shorter length. Chandimal looks to cut but is beaten but the extra bounce.

Huge appeal but nothing from the umpire! Abbas bowls an off cutter outside off, which jags back in after pitching. Perera prods forward to block it but misses and is struck on the pads. Abbas is literally is pleading but the umpire remains put. It looked mighty close but not to forget, Pakistan have lost both their reviews.
Length ball on off, Perera defends it towards covers.

Lovely timing by the off spinner! Abbas bowls a full ball outside off, wanting the batsman to drive. Dilruwan does so and does it really well, he times it through wide mid off. Azhar Ali there gives it a chase and does well to keep it down to two.
Good length ball on off, Dilruwan defends it solidly.
Back of a length on off, Perera defends it off the back foot.
Angles it on the pads, Chandimal flicks it through backward square leg for a run.
Mohammad Abbas will bowl from the other end.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. This is now Yasir Shah's highest spell in UAE and second in his career.
BEATEN! Yasir bowls it shorter in length outside off, bounces a touch more. Perera goes for the cut but gets beaten.
Drags his length back on middle, Perera goes on the back foot and whips it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Tosses it up on off, Perera prods forward in defense.
Nicely bowled by Shah! He bowls it slower through the air on middle, does not turn. Dilruwan tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Flatter in length on leg stump. Chandimal flicks it through square leg for a run.

We're ready to get underway after the long break. The umpires and the players walk out to the middle. Dinesh Chandimal and Dilruwan Perera will continue their innings. Yasir Shah will start off after lunch. He has a slip in place.
...Day 2, Session 2...

There wasn't much assistance for the Pakistan bowlers from the track, making it hard to pick wickets. The heat hasn't done them much good either. They could have had one more scalp, but Dilruwan Perera was lucky enough to edge them on a couple of occasions to survive the leg before scares. The Lankans are in a dominating position as things stand, so the hosts need early wickets in the next session. It will be a longer break due to the Friday prayers, one hour to be exact. So join us for the second session at 1330 local time.

A thoroughly satisfying effort from the Sri Lankans in this opening session - 95 runs have been scored for the loss of just one wicket in 33 overs. Niroshan Dickwella was the only player to fall, but he didn't depart before making a significant contribution. Scored a brisk 83 and contributed well to a massive 134-run partnership with his skipper, who has an unbeaten ton to his name going into the break.
Flatter on middle, Perera keeps it out off the back foot and THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 2!
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Fuller in length and outside off, Chandimal drives it through mid off for a run.
Works it with the spin to the man at mid-wicket.
Tosses it up on middle, Dinesh works it to mid-wicket.
Comes around the wicket and bowls it on the pads. Chandimal flicks it to square leg.
Comes down the track and drives it through mid off for a run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Darts it down the leg side, Perera goes for the sweep but misses.
Drags his length back outside off, Chandimal cuts it through covers for a run.
He is finally off the mark! Sohail flights it on middle, Perera comes down the track and goes over mid on. The fielder there gives it a chase and saves a run for his team.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Works it with the angle on the leg side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter on off, turning back in. Chandimal flicks it to mid-wicket.
Works it to mid-wicket with the spin.
Shorter in length outside off, Chandimal cuts it through the off side for a brace.
Fires it down the leg side, Chandimal flicks it fine down the leg side for a couple.
Asad Shafiq is into the attack.

NOT OUT! Oh my my! He is edging them perfectly. Yes, there is an inside edge this time also. So, another successful review by Dilruwan. The move to get Sohail on almost paid off. Haris bowls it quicker and full on middle. Dilruwan tries to work it on the leg side but fails to. He falls over and is struck on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Dilruwan after a chat reviews it. Time for the replays now and there is some spark on the Ultra Edge. After looking at a lot of replays, the TV umpire finally asks the on-field umpire to overturn his decision. Perera survives another scare!
Another review by Dilruwan as he is given LBW but this time he looks out unless there is an inside edge again.
Flatter and an arm ball on middle, Perera does well to keep it out.
Full on leg stump, Chandimal flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shorter in length outside off. Dinesh pushes it to covers.
Starts off with a short delivery which sticks into the wicket. Chandimal is early into the flick and gets a soft leading edge back to the bowler.
Haris Sohail is into the attack.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Googly on leg stump. Perera works it to square leg.
BEATEN! Lovely, lovely bowling by Yasir. He bowls this one slower outside off. Perera tries to defend it but gets beaten as it turns away after pitching.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Flatter delivery on middle, Dilruwan tucks it to mid-wicket.
Turn! Floats it outside off, Dilruwan lunges forward in defense but gets beaten by the away turn.
Bowls it outside off, Dinesh does not fiddle with it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

FOUR! Hundred for the skipper, what a knock it has been. His 10th Test century and first as a captain. He acknowledges the applause from the dressing room and his celebration just shows how much it means to him. Amir dishes out a very full ball outside off, a half-volley. Chandimal crashes it through covers for a boundary.
Comes over the wicket and angles it across the batsman but it is wide enough for him to not play at it.
Wide outside off again, wanting Chandimal to go after it but he resists the temptation and lets it be.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Lovely bowling! Bowls it quicker on middle, the ball skids off the surface. Dilruwan somehow manages to keep it out at the last moment.
Shorter in length outside off, Dilruwan pushes it to covers.
A googly by Yasir but goes straight on. Perera does well to keep it out.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floats it on off, Perera lunges forward in defense.
Flatter outside off, Perera tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
A change in action there by Amir. Also bowls it slower in pace at a fuller length on middle. Chandimal pushes it towards mid on.
Amir comes steaming in and lands it on a length outside off. Chandimal with a lot of ease defends it.
Good length on off, Chandimal defends it solidly.
Shorter in length outside off, Chandimal cuts it towards Shah at point who misfields. He may have taken his eye off the ball at the last second and concedes two.
Fuller in length outside off, inviting Chandimal to drive. He obliges and drives it through the covers but it does not have enough to reach the boundary, the batsmen run two.
Lands it on a length on off, Chandimal defends it off the front foot.
Stays right behind the line and keeps it out safely to end the over.
Short, turning away and from outside off, Dilruwan goes back for the big pull but the ball goes under his bat because of the low bounce.
Slightly fullish in length around off, Dilruwan meets it with the full face of the bat.
Tad short around off, goes back and keeps it out off the back foot.

Not out! Massive inside edge so that's a good review from the batsman. He was sure he was going to be safe from the first second itself, not sure how the umpire missed that though. The leggie bowls a flipper on middle, it goes on straight as Dilruwan comes half-forward in defense. Gets hit on the pads and there's a huge appeal. The umpire wastes no time in raising his finger but Perera decides to review almost in the same motion. He is confident of the inside edge. Replays confirm there was a thick inside edge so he's saved. Agony for Pakistan, they'd have liked another breakthrough at this stage. Dilruwan survives.
Review time! Dilruwan Perera is caught leg before, given out but he's instantly reviewed it. Inside edge is the only thing that will save him, and he seems pretty confident about it. Let's see now...
Tossed up outside off, driven to mid off for a single.
Lands it on a length on middle, Perera blocks it watchfully.
Good length on off, Perera defends it off the front foot.
Angles it on the pads, Chandimal flicks it through square leg for three.
Lands it on a length on off, Chandimal defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller in length outside off, Chandimal drives it through covers for a couple.
Mohammad Amir is into the attack.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tosses it up on off, Perera defends it off the front foot.
Flatter on middle, Dilruwan gets it off the inner half towards short leg.

Tosses it on leg stump, Chandimal flicks it through square leg. Hasan Ali who just finished his over, hares after it and puts in a slide and does really well to keep it down to one. He also hurt himself in the process as he made the effort on the hard surface but he seems to be alright.
The bouncer this time also a well-directed one. Perera ducks under it.
Good length ball outside off, Perera guides it to point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Lovely delivery by Hasan! He has his tail up after the wicket. He bowls it very full on off, almost a yorker. Perera does well to dig it out.
Fuller in length outside off, Perera tries to drive it through the off side but gets a bottom edge back to the bowler.
Dilruwan Perera is the next man in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Finally a wicket for Pakistan, and Hasan Ali provides it. He gets another drag on. Hasan Ali comes steaming in and lands it on a length around off, the ball stays a touch low. Dickwella tries to play it with an angled bat but gets an inside edge onto the stumps. A lazy shot you can say. He can't believe it and is not happy with himself. He walks back dejected as he misses out on a hundred. Nevertheless, this is now his highest score in Test cricket. Pakistan are ecstatic. A very good innings comes to an end. The 134-run stand is now broken and Pakistan would now want to build on this.
Loopy ball on off, Chandimal drives it firmly but straight to the man at covers.

FOUR! Poor by Yasir! The heat maybe getting to him. A tired delivery by Shah. Short and wide outside off, Chandimal had all the time in the world to rock back and cut it through covers for a boundary.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
This time to his right! Dickwella plays the reverse sweep again but does not quite time it that well towards short third man for a run.

FOUR! This time he nails the reverse sweep to perfection. Yasir bowls a leg spinner outside off. Dickwella goes down on one knee and reverse sweeps it past the diving Hasan Ali at point for a boundary.
Tosses it up on off, Dickwella defends it stoutly.
Again some seam movement into the batsman for Ali. Chandimal works it to mid-wicket.
Hasan is getting some swing here! He bowls a full delivery on off, swinging back in. Chandimal with a straight bat drives it to mid off.
Shorter in length outside off, skids off the surface and also jags back in a touch. Chandimal cuts it to the man at point.
Tucks it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Serves it full and wide of off stump. Chandimal's eyes lit up as he saw width on offer. He slashes at the ball and gets it through covers. Due to the slow outfield the batsman only pick up two.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Not convincing but Dickwella will take it. He is nimble on his feet and gets to the pitch of the ball and whips it uppishly through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Seeing Dickwella go for the reverse sweep, Yasir fires it quicker. Niroshan mistimes his shot to backward point.
Signs of Yasir tiring a bit. He bowls it short and outside off, Dickwella cuts it through covers for a couple.

Loopy ball outside off, turning back in. Dickwella tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball falls onto the ground. Niroshan was lucky there, that could have easily popped up to the close-in fielders.
Yasir tosses it up outside off, Dickwella with the turn plays the sweep shot. He fails to keep it down but it falls well short of the fielder at deep square leg who fumbles and concedes two.
Shorter in length from Yasir, Dickwella defends it off the back foot.
Good length delivery, gets some shape into the batsman. Chandimal watchfully blocks it.
Good length around off, Chandimal defends it off the front foot.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. Chandimal gets inside the line and works it to mid-wicket.
Dishes out a full delivery outside off. Chandimal drives it towards Azhar Ali at mid off who makes a good tumbling stop.
Niroshan with the angle plays it towards mid on for a run.
Angles it into the batsman. Dickwella flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Time for Drinks! Dickwella and Chandimal are playing really well and would want to continue the same. Pakistan are in desperate need of a wicket here or they will be facing a big score.
Drags his length back on middle, Chandimal rocks back and punches it to mid on.
Flatter on off, does not spin and goes on with the arm. Chandimal defends it solidly.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted delivery outside off, Chandimal drives it uppishly but short of the fielder at cover.
Loopy ball on off, but very full. Chandimal does not let it turn as he gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to mid off.
Anything full and outside off, Dickwella will sweep it. Yasir tosses it up outside off. Dickwella goes down on one knee and sweeps it down to deep square leg for a run.
Back of a length on middle, Chandimal tucks it to mid-wicket.
Works it with the angle to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Delightful! Hasan Ali bowls it fuller in length on off, Chandimal leans into it and drives it through the gap between covers and mid off for a boundary. This shot was so pleasing to the eye.
Comes running in and goes wide of the crease. He angles it into the batsman. Chandimal flicks it through backward square leg for a brace.
Lands it on a length outside off, Dickwella pushes it towards the cover fielder for a run.
He comes around the wicket to Dickwella and serves a fuller length ball on off. Dickwella drives it to the man at mid off.
Hasan Ali is back into the attack.
Flatter and fuller down the leg side. Chandimal flicks it towards square leg.
First signs of turn today! That was a lovely delivery by Yasir. He bowls a flighted ball on off, which turns away sharply. Chandimal lunges forward but gets beaten.
Loopy ball on off, Chandimal eases it to mid off.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floats it very full on middle, Dinesh drives it straight to the man at covers.
Slower through the air on middle, Chandimal pushes it past the bowler. The mid on fielder runs to his left and covers up.
He is varying his length really well. He bangs it in short now. Dickwella ducks under it.
He bowls a yorker this time on middle. This is very good thinking by Abbas. Chandimal does very well to jam it out towards mid-wicket for a run.
In the channel just outside off, on a length. Dinesh lunges forward in defense.
A change in length, he bowls it fuller on off. Chandimal defends it solidly.
Bangs in a bouncer but down the leg side. Chandimal watches it early and ducks under it.
Short again! This time Dickwella is up for the challenge and pulls it through square leg for a run.
Fires it on off, turning away and also stays low. Chandimal does well to adjust and push it to covers.
Flatter on off, Chandimal defends it from within the crease.
Tosses it up on off, Chandimal defends it solidly.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Too short by Yasir! He bowls it short and also provides room. Chandimal is too good to miss out on that. He cuts it through the covers. The ball teases the fielder Azam who is giving it a chase but eventually the ball wins.
Innovation! Dickwella goes for the reverse sweep but does not time it well. Still manages to get it through point for a run.
Just behind a length outside off, Niroshan pushes it through the off side for a run.

Almost! Pakistan persisting with the short ball almost pays off. Abbas bowls a well-directed bouncer on leg stump. Dickwella goes for the pull but misses and it goes to the keeper. The players appeal but nothing from the umpire. That was really close to the glove.

Back of a length on middle, Chandimal hops and plays it with soft hands towards mid-wicket area for a run. this also brings up the 100-run stand between the two. This has been a really vital partnership for the home side.
A shorter in length delivery on middle. Chandimal does well to evade it.
A change in tactic maybe from Pakistan! A bouncer by Abbas. Chandimal does well to duck under it.
Abbas trying something different. He bangs it short on leg stump. Dickwella swivels inside his crease and pulls it through backward square leg for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Quicker outside off, Chandimal does not fiddle with it.
FOUR! LOVELY! Yasir tosses it up outside off, inviting Chandimal to drive. He obliges and does it beautifully through the covers for a boundary. That was really nicely played.
Floats it on off, Chandimal taps it towards point. they think of a run but seeing the fielder get to the ball quickly opts against it.
Flatter on off, turning away. Dinesh defends it onto the ground.
Yasir gives it flight on middle. Dickwella sees the air given and comes down the track and drives it down to long on for a run.
Just short of a length on off, Chandimal pushes it to the man at mid off.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside. A committed effort by the fielder to save runs for his team.
Lands it on a length around off, bounces a touch more. Chandimal does well to play it down towards covers. He wants a run but is sent back by his partner.
Just ahead of a length on off, Chandimal drives it on the up to mid off.
That was really nicely timed! Abbas bowls it fuller outside off, Dickwella drives it square through the off side. There is protection in the deep so the batsmen get only one.
Flatter delivery outside off. Chandimal lets it be.
Bowls a flipper, which skids off the surface. Dickwella works it around the corner for a run.
Gives it air this time and bowls it on off. Dickwella covers the line and blocks it.
A googly by Yasir outside off. Dickwella goes on the back foot and defends it.
Brings out the sweep which he has played so well but hits it straight to backward square leg.
Slower through the air on middle, Dickwella lets it turn and works it through square leg.
Good length on off, Chandimal defends it solidly.
A slower ball down the leg side. Too easy for Chandimal who flicks it in front of square and runs two.
Fuller in length outside off. Dinesh drives it straight to the man at mid off.
Lands it on a length around off. Chandimal drives it to mid off.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.

Errs in line and angles it on the pads. Dickwella fails to flick and is struck on the pads as the ball rolls towards the leg side. The players appeal but it is an ambitious one. The umpire remains put and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Slower through the air, outside off, but it is too full. Chandimal mistimes his drive to the cover fielder.
Gives it air on middle, Chandimal with the turn drives it to covers.
Clips it with the turn to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Comes dancing down the track and flicks it straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Floats it on off, turning back in. Dickwella lunges forward and defends it.
Yasir bowls a flatter delivery, a leg spinner on middle. Dickwella lets it turn and works it to mid-wicket.
Time for some spin now! Yasir Shah is into the attack. He was their best bowler yesterday and Pakistan desperately need him to take a wicket.

Good batting by Dickwella, he has really been impressive today! Abbas bowls it on a length outsdie off. Dickwella guides it towards deep point and keeps strike for the next over. With Niroshan at the crease, runs will come at a good pace for the Lankans.
Fuller in length but not full enough to drive. Dickwella lunges forward and blocks it.
Pulls his length back on off, Dickwella camps back and defends it.
The batsman drives the ball straight back to the bowler.
Better delivery! He goes wide of the crease and lands it on off, gets it to shape away after pitching. Dickwella is up for it and defends it solidly.
Straightaway comes around the wicket and angles it into the batsman. Dickwella shuffles across and flicks it to mid-wicket.
An early change! Mohammad Abbas is into the attack.
Changes his length, bowls it fuller in length on off, Chandimal defends it with authority.
Around the wicket now! He comes steaming in and lands it on a length. The ball pitches and comes slow off the wicket. Chandimal defends it off the back foot.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Fuller in length outside off, Chandimal tries to drive but gets an inside edge back to the bowler. Maybe he could not time it due to the slowness of wicket.
Comes over the wicket now to the right-hander. He lands it on a length on middle, angling across the batsman. Chandimal watchfully defends it.
Slower ball by Amir on middle, Dickwella reads it well, waits for it and flicks it through square leg to rotate strike.

Fuller in length on middle, Chandimal shuffles across and flicks it through square leg. The outfield has not improved since yesterday and it does not quite get to the boundary. the fielder hares after it and cuts it off. The batsmen take two.
Just behind a length on off, Chandimal defends it from within the crease.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Due to the prayers, the first session has been extended by half an hour and the lunch break will be for an hour.  Also, last session will be deducted by half an hour.
Back of a length on off, Niroshan taps it in front of covers for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Dickwella cuts it to the man at point.
Comes around the wicket and bowls it on a length outside off. Dickwella lets it be.
Nicley timed! Shorter in length by Amir outside off, Dickwella goes back and across and punches it through backward point. Yasir Shah there gives it a chase and saves a run for his side.
Lands it on a length on off, Dickwella defends it off the front foot.

EDGY FOUR! Dickwella has scored two boundaries and both in that region. Amir bowls it a tad fuller outside off, which stays a touch low. Dickwella feels for it and gets an outside edge which goes past the diving second slip fielder and into the fence. He has managed to score some quick runs today.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

BEATEN! This one took off the pitch. Amir puts in more effort in this ball. He lands it on a length around off, the ball gets big on Dickwella who pokes at it and gets beaten. That was really close to the edge. Lovely bowling by Amir.
Good length outside off, does not bounce at all. Dickwella lets it be and Sarfraz collects it really low.
Good length on off, nips away after pitching. Chandimal defends it towards point.
Fuller in length outside off, Dickwella square drives it through point for a run.

Fifty for Dickwella, a vital knock by the wicketkeeper. His 6th in Tests. Hasan bowls a ball shorter in length outside off, Dickwella guides it down towards third man. The fielder in the deep runs to his right, dives and makes a good stop. Two runs taken.

FOUR! An early boundary today. A streaky one but Dickwella won't mind. Hasan Ali lands it on a length outside off. Niroshan tries to drive it away from his body but gets an outside edge through the slip cordon and the ball races to the fence.
First runs for the day! Hasan Ali bowls it shorter in length at the hips of the batsman. Dickwella flicks it through square leg for a brace.
He starts off with a fuller length delivery on middle, looking for some swing but there isn't any. Dickwella tries to drive it straight down the ground but gets it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Hasan Ali will bowl from the other end.
A touch fuller in length around off, Chandimal times his drive beautifully but straight to the cover fielder. A maiden to start off by Amir.
Pulls his length back a little on off, Chandimal off the back foot defends it onto the ground.
Amir bowls it on a length around off, angling into the batsman. Chandimal keeps his eyes on the ball and blocks it.
Fuller in length outside off, Dinesh opts not to fiddle with it.
Again lands it on a similar length on off, stays a touch low. Chandimal lunges forward and defends it.

Straightaway lack of bounce! Amir comes running in and starts off with a length delivery outside off, gets some seam movement away from the batsman. Chandimal plants his front foot ahead and lets it be.
The men concerned are out in the middle. Dinesh Chandimal and Niroshan Dickwella will resume their innings. Mohammad Amir will start off the proceedings. Here we go...

Pakistan, on the other hand, would want to make good use of the second new ball before it gets soft. They would look to chip away at the wickets and not let the Lankans run away with the game. The wicket is still good to bat on, with only little assistance for the spinners and to Sri Lanka's benefit, the home side has only one specialist spinner. We are in for an exciting day of cricket.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of Day 2 of the first Test between Pakistan and Sri Lanka at the Sheikh Zayed Stadium, Abu Dhabi. We head into the day with the visitors the happier of the two sides. Their captain, Dinesh Chandimal, is leading from the front and he along with the rest will hope to continue from where they left off yesterday.
...Day 2, Session 1...

Earlier in the day the hosts had the away side on the mat at 61 for 3 but were flat with their bowling, not putting enough pressure on the tourists. The century stand between Karunaratne and Chandimal ensured that the visitors were in the game. The wicket is not providing a lot of assistance and Yasir Shah was the only bowler who looked threatening. Pakistan would look to come out tomorrow, take wickets and restrict the Lankans to a moderate total. The Islanders though would look to build on this platform and get somewhere close to 400. Join us for all the action on Day 2 at 1000 local (0600 GMT). Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Another session which has belonged to the visitors, scoring 84 runs in 31 overs. If not for the bizarre run out of Karunaratne who deserved a hundred, it would have been an even better one. Nevertheless, their captain has led from the front and is unbeaten on 60 and has got support from Dickwella who is eyeing a half century. Sri Lanka, all in all will be very happy with their position in the game, after having started poorly.
Floated outside off, Dickwella leans forward and smothers the turn. THAT'S STUMPS ON DAY 1!
On the pads, clipped to backward square leg.
Quicker one down the leg side, Niroshan goes for a sweep but misses. Ahmed collects it and for some reason appeals. Unsuccessfully though.

Nervy moment! Landed on off, spinning away. Chandimal taps it to covers and sets off for a run. Azam goes across to his left and picks it up with his left hand. He lobs the ball to his right hand and makes a wayward throw to Ahmed. That allows Dickwella to get home safely.
Quicker through the air outside off, Dinesh makes a watchful leave.
Fullish on middle, Chandimal goes for the push but gets it off the inner half to mid on.
Similar length outside off, stays low. Dickwella points his bat skywards to let it go.
On a length outside off, left alone.
Fuller in length around off, kept out watchfully.
FOUR! Crisp! Half-volley outside off, Dickwella leans ahead and just times his stroke. Gets it through covers and the ball whistles away to the ropes.
That's a jaffa! Length delivery coming in initially with the angle. After hitting the deck, it seams away. Dickwella feels for it but is beaten all ends up.
FOUR! A bit risky but safe! Fullish around off, Dickwella drives it on the up. It just beats the mid off fielder and races to the fence.
Hasan Ali to bowl the penultimate over of the day.
Short outside off, pushed to covers.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.

Not Out! According to the new rules, the reviews don't get refreshed and Pakistan have exhausted them now. Quicker through the air around leg stump, spinning back sharply. Chandimal looks to keep it out but misses to be rapped on the pads. Sarfraz takes the review after having a look at his bowler. Time for the replays. It is pitching outside leg and the story ends there.
Sarfraz after a thought decides to opt for the review against an LBW decision. Chandimal is the man in question. Seems to be pitching outside leg.
Fullish delivery around off, Chandimal defends it solidly.
Floated on off, Chandimal lunges forward in defense.
Tossed up on middle and leg, played with soft hands to mid on.
The players are taking a bit of a breather. Three overs are left in the day. Meanwhile, Yasir Shah is called back for a bowl.
Full delivery attacking the base of the off stump. Dickwella does well to jam it out to mid off.
Good length delivery outside off, played with an angled bat to backward point.
Change of pace. Off-cutter outside off on a fullish length. Dickwella taps it with an open face of the bat to point.
Fuller in length outside off, Dickwella leans ahead to stroke it to covers.
Length delivery outside off, pushed off the back foot back to the bowler.

FOUR! Cheeky! He plays such shots with a lot of command! Short delivery outside off, takes ages to come towards Dickwella. He rises up on his toes and ramps it deftly over the slip cordon to find the fence.
On the hips this time, tucked through mid-wicket for a run.
Fullish delivery outside off, Dickwella goes for the drive but mistimes it to mid off. Got it from the toe-end of his bat.

Length delivery around off, Dickwella pushes it with minimal foot movement and gets it off the outer half past gully. Masood sprints after it, slides near the fence and makes a terrific stop. The umpires check for it upstairs but it is fine. He saves two for his side.
Straying on the hips, Chandimal tickles it down to fine leg for a run. That brings up the 50-run stand between the duo. Good batting from them.
In the zone outside off, holding its line. Dinesh doesn't fiddle with it.
Fullish delivery outside off, eased through covers for a single.

Leg bye! On a length, angling in sharply. Dickwella looks to play it across but is struck on the thigh pad. There is a stifled appeal from Amir and Co. but the umpire is not interested. That was clearly heading down leg.
Length delivery on off, Dickwella works it to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Streaky boundary! Fullish delivery well outside off, swinging away. Dickwella plays away from the body and ends up getting a thick outside edge past the diving second slip fielder and through to the fence.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On a length, Niroshan covers the line to keep it out.
Due to that shot by Dickwella the square leg goes out now.
SIX! What a shot! Hint of Jayasuriya in that stroke! Fuller in length on off, Dickwella just picks it up and dumps it over the deep square leg fence. First maximum of the game. Wristwork at its best.
Fullish around off, eased to covers.

Not Out! Good use of the review by the Sri Lankan skipper! Fullish delivery outside off, swinging in. Chandimal plants his front foot across and decides to pad it away. The Pakistanis roar in unison and umpire Richard Kettleborough, after a thought, decides to rule it out. However, Dinesh opts to review it. The repays roll in. The ball hasn't come back enough to hit the off stump. Dinesh survives!
Chandimal opts to take a review against an LBW decision. He hasn't offered any stroke. Looks close to the naked eye.
Straying on the pads, Dinesh turns it through backward square leg. Masood sprints after it and slides to stop it. Two runs taken.
Full length delivery outside off, Dickwella drives it towards backward point for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Dickwella punches it towards gully where Masood dives full length to his right to save a certain boundary. The fast bowlers are pairing well.
Mohammad Abbas to share the second new ball from the other end.
In the zone outside off, angling away. Chandimal leaves it alone.
Stays back to the length delivery and defends it watchfully.
Amir brings out his stock delivery, the inswinger but the line is down the leg side. Chandimal looks to play it across but wears it on the pads.

Rush of blood from Chandimal! Full length delivery outside off, slanting across. The Sri Lankan skipper goes for an expansive drive but is beaten on the inside edge. He needs to be careful, can't afford to lose a wicket at the fag end of the day.
Fullish delivery on off, Dickwella clips it to backward square leg to rotate strike.
Dickwella has a change of bat. He might not be happy with the old one.
Second new ball has been taken.
Good length delivery around off, Dickwella camps back and dabs it to point.
Mohammad Amir returns for his final spell of the day.
Quicker delivery outside off, cut to cover-point.

Shah slips in the googly this time. Chandimal shuffles across and decides to pad it away. The ball lobs over the keeper and goes to the fence. It has been signaled a dead ball as no stroke was offered.
Tossed up delivery, Chandimal negotiates it off the front foot.
Fullish on off, patted back to the bowler.
Outside off, spinning away. Dinesh lets it go.
Dickwella takes on the sweep from outside off but gets it off the inner half towards short fine leg. Chandimal calls for the run straightaway. He beats the throw at the striker's end with ease.
Well-directed bouncer from Ali. Chandimal ducks under it in time to evade it.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Ali loses hid radar this time. Slips this on a length down the leg side. The Sri Lankan skipper moves inside the line and tucks it through short fine leg to find the fence.
In the channel outside off, Chandimal doesn't fiddle with it.
Hint of reverse swing this time! Fullish delivery outside off, tailing in nicely. Chandimal knows where his off stump is and makes a good leave. When you get rhythm right, things start happening.
Full length delivery outside off, eased to covers for an easy run.
Starts off with a loose delivery down the leg side, helped to backward square leg to rotate strike.

Asad Shafiq is back on. Well, he was about to bowl, but then Pakistan change their mind and Hasan Ali is brought onto bowl. Also, the new ball is now available and as per the new rules the reviews are not refreshed.
Drifting in to Chandimal. Worked with the spin through mid-wicket and he will retain the strike.
The short leg goes out to a deepish mid-wicket.
Quicker delivery outside off, Chandimal covers his off stump and leaves it alone.

FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Half-tracker on off, Chandimal rocks back and pulls it with aplomb over mid-wicket for a boundary. This brings up his 13th Test fifty! It has been a measured knock by him. Needs to convert it into a big one.
Floated outside off, pushed off the front foot to the same region.
Tossed up outside off, eased to covers.
Shortish around off, cut to short cover.
Length delivery on off, Dickwella opts to stay back and defend it.

Full length delivery well outside off, Dickwella goes for a drive but is early into his shot. Gets it off the outer half past Shah at backward point. He rushes after it, slides near the fence and keeps the ball in play. Saves a couple for his side. He is perhaps the fastest Pakistani fielder, good commitment.
Length delivery on off, Dickwella camps back and defends it. His bottom hand came off while blocking it.
Hurled a bit wider outside off this time. Niroshan plants his front foot across to leave it.
That's a peach! Good length delivery outside off, angling in initially and seaming away a touch after hitting the deck. Dickwella pushes at it with minimal foot movement but gets beaten.
Fuller in length around off, Dickwella eases it to covers.
Flatter one outside off, forced off the back foot to the same fielder again.
Slow through the air outside off, Chandimal drives it crisply to short cover.
Floated on off, the Sri Lankan skipper lunges forward in defense.
Spinning into Dinesh. Played with the spin to mid-wicket.
Dickwella kneels and goes for the big sweep this time. Gets it towards the backward square leg fielder who dives to his right to make a great stop. A run taken.
Floated delivery on off, Dickwella paddles it around the corner. The short fine leg fielder hares after it and does well to stop two runs for his side.
Good length delivery outside off, stays low again. Chandimal tries to cut it but misses.
Good length delivery in the zone of apprehension, holding its line. Dinesh points his bat skywards to allow it through.
FOUR! Good wristwork from the Sri Lankan skipper. Angling into Chandimal, he tucks it through square leg with good timing and the ball whistles away to the fence.
Fuller in length outside off, Dinesh puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Back of a length delivery outside off, stays low. Chandimal is beaten on the cut.
Length delivery around off, kept out off the back foot.
Sweeps this one again but finds the man at short leg.
Down the leg side, Dickwella looks to play it across but misses.

Not out! Pakistan waste a review! Floated around off, Dickwella kneels to sweep but seems to have missed it. Ahmed takes it down the leg side and appeals loudly. He is confident that there is some glove on it. Time for the replays. The Snickometer doesn't spot any glove. In fact, there is no deflection. A review goes down the drain.
Sarfraz Ahmed is confident regarding a caught behind shout and straightaway takes the review. Is there glove involved?
Uses his feet to the quicker delivery, is not to the pitch of it and ends up taking it on the body.
FOUR! Innovative! He is such a kind of a player who likes to take on the bowler. Tossed up outside off, Dickwella reverse sweeps it through short third man for a boundary.
Fullish around off, Dickwella sweeps it the short leg fielder.
Fullish delivery outside off, Chandimal goes for a drive but gets it off the inner half towards the bowler.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Great shot! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Chandimal knocks it through extra cover to find the fence.
Back of a length outside off, Niroshan punches it to covers and takes off. It is a tight run but the shy at the non-striker's end misses. Running has been dodgy after the break.
Similar length delivery outside off, Dickwella plays it with soft hands to the off side.
Length delivery around off, Dickwella hangs back to block it to covers.
Hasan Ali is back into the attack.
Time for Drinks.
Stays back to this one and blocks it.
This time the Sri Lankan skipper decides to pad away the delivery outside leg.
Spinning in sharply from outside leg. Chandimal looks to defend but is struck on the back pad.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fullish on middle and leg, Chandimal taps it towards mid-wicket. Looks for a run but it is not on offer.
Spinning away from Chandimal. He stays back and punches it to point.
Angling in sharply on a fuller length on middle. Dickwella plays it with soft hands to mid-wicket. End of a testing over.
Short delivery outside off, takes ages to come to Dickwella. He thinks about the ramp but doesn't go for it.
Very full delivery on middle, tailing in. Dickwella does well to bring his bat down in time.
Full length delivery outside off, Dickwella drives it to extra cover where Azam dives to his left to stop it.
On a length and angling into Niroshan. Played with the angle to mid-wicket.
Length delivery on off, Dickwella camps back and defends it stoutly.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Leg stump line again, padded away.
Spinning away sharply from around the leg stump, Chandimal lunges to block but gets it off the outer half to backward point. This is a good angle to operate from.
Full delivery outside leg stump, Chandimal uses his feet and somehow manages to jam it out.
On the pads again, clipped to mid-wicket.
Around leg stump, Chandimal prods forward and defends it off the outer half to silly point.
Just ahead of a length outside off. Niroshan, off the front foot pushes it to covers.
A tad fuller in length outside off. Dickwella pushes it to covers.
Brilliant, brilliant bowling by Amir. He bowls an inswinging yorker from wide of the crease. It was delivered at a good pace. Dickwella does extremely well to keep it out.
Errs in line and drifts it on the pads. Chandimal flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Slower ball on a fuller length outside off. Dinesh tries to drive but is early on the shot. He mistimes it to mid off.
Amir comes steaming in and lands it on a length around off. Chandimal defends it towards covers.
Flatter delivery, spinning down. Dickwella looks to block it but wears it on the thigh pad.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the front foot.

Not Out! Umpire's call saves a review for Pakistan! Flatter delivery around off, spinning in. Dickwella looks to keep it out but misses to get rapped on the pads. There is a huge appeal for an LBW but it is turned down. Yasir Shah has a look at his skipper and they look confident. Pakistan take the review. The replays show that the impact is umpire's call and it is also clipping the top of off stump. Since there was umpire's call involved, the home side does not lose a review according to the new rules.
A review for LBW has been taken against Dickwella. The impact might be just outside off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated around off, Dickwella goes for a paddle sweep but gets a top edge towards fine leg. Two runs taken and he is away.
Niroshan Dickwella comes out to bat.

OUT! What a sad way to depart! Tossed up delivery on off, Karunaratne clips it wide of mid on and straightaway calls for a run. Chandimal takes off initially but then refuses. Abbas goes across to his right, picks up the ball and returns an accurate throw to Sarfraz who does the rest. Dimuth is absolutely gutted. The southpaw surely deserved a century but has to walk back disappointed. The Sri Lankan skipper sold him a dummy down the river. This is the second time in the space of five innings that he has lost his wicket in the nineties in Test cricket. Nevertheless, a terrific knock comes to an end and also the 100-run stand. Can the hosts trigger a collapse now?
Back of a length outside off, some extra bounce on that. Chandimal is surprised by it but does well to punch it to covers.
Fuller in length outside off, perhaps the slower one. Chandimal is drawn early into the drive and hence, gets it off the inner half down the track.
Good length delivery outside off, angling in. Chandimal with a high elbow blocks it to covers.
Fuller in length outside off, angling in. Dinesh doesn't fiddle with it.
Full length delivery on middle and leg this time. Helped with the angle to mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery slanting across Chandimal. He covers his off stump and allows it to go through.
Mohammad Amir is back for a burst.
Quicker and flatter outside off, Karunaratne makes good use of the depth of the crease to block it.
Floated outside off, Dimuth prods forward in defense.
Once again Karunaratne finds Masood at short leg. Tight bowling from Shah.
Fullish on middle, worked towards short leg where Masood shows good reflexes to stop it.
Similar delivery, flicked towards Azam at mid-wicket again who dives to his left to save certain runs for his side.
Fullish on off, clipped nicely to mid-wicket.

Fullish delivery outside off, Dimuth pushes at it but gets it off the outer half to point. A run taken. That brings up the 100-run stand. These two are ticking along nicely. They have been patient and haven't taken any unnecessary chances.
Bowls this on a driving length wide outside off, trying to bring the wide slip and two gully fielders into play. Karunaratne resists the temptation and leaves it alone.
Slower delivery outside off, Karunaratne plays it with an angled bat to point and looks for a run. However, his partner shouts no.
Fullish in length, angling in. Defended solidly off the front foot.
Straying on the pads, helped through backward square leg for a couple. These two are playing sensible cricket.

No ball! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Dimuth drives it sweetly to extra cover where Azhar Ali dives to his right to make a good stop. Abbas has overstepped this time. This is the second no ball of the innings.
Fullish in length angling in from around off. Karunaratne stays low and clips it to short mid-wicket.
Quicker through the air outside off, Chandimal plants his front foot across to let it go.
Allows the ball to come to him again and punches it with the spin to mid off.
Similar length delivery outside off, cut to covers.
A fraction short outside off, punched off the back foot to extra cover.
Fullish outside off, driven crisply to mid off.
Drifting onto the pads, worked past short leg for a run. Karunaratne moves into the nineties with that.
Fullish delivery outside off, tapped to covers.
Full length delivery on middle, clipped to mid-wicket this time.

Fullish delivery on the boots, the Sri Lankan skipper turns it past the diving short mid-wicket fielder. Shah sprints after it and keeps it down to a couple. The back up was once again not good as Abbas failed to stop it but fortunately, a cover fielder was in place.
Good length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, holding its line. Chandimal watches it closely and allows it to go through.
On a length, angling in. Chandimal works it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery in the off stump channel. Chandimal answers it with a straight bat.
Flatter delivery, kept out watchfully.

Rare attempt to play a sweep shot! Floated outside off, Karunaratne looks to paddle it to fine leg but the extra bounce deceives him. Gets hit on the arm and the ball lobs towards the vacant silly point region.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, turning in. Dimuth prods forward and pads it away.
Fullish delivery on off, Karunaratne clips it to mid on.
Shortish delivery, punched off the back foot to covers.
Fuller in length outside off, eased to covers off the front foot.
In the channel outside off, Dinesh doesn't flirt with it.
Fullish delivery around off, shaping in. Chandimal covers the line and defends it stoutly.

Five runs! Fullish around off, tapped with an open bat face to point. Dimuth sets off for a run. There is a shy at the non-striker's end which misses. The fielder, Hasan Ali who is backing up makes a mess of it. Allows it to go through to the fence. Sloppy work!
Good length delivery on off, worked off the back foot to mid-wicket.
On a length outside off, a bit of inward shape on that and after pitching, it seams away. Karunaratne knows where his off stump is and makes a good leave.
Sharp turn on this occasion! Slow through the air around off, Chandimal initially looks to drive it with the spin but bails out at the last moment.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fullish outside off, played with soft hands to covers.
Floated outside off, knocked to mid off. Chandimal looks for a run but decides against it.
Shorter in length again, Chandimal cuts it with the spin through point. Two runs taken.
Shortish around off, eased towards point.
Fullish delivery on the pads, Dimuth clips it through in front of square leg for a couple. Ruins a maiden over which was there for the taking.

Good fielding! Coming in with the angle. Karunaratne clips it to mid-wicket and sets off for a run but is sent back by his partner. The fielder there runs to his left, dives and makes a good stop. Has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Length delivery around off, Dimuth taps it to the same region.
Fuller in length outside off, patted to covers.
A bit ahead of a length on off, the southpaw puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Length delivery on off, Karunaratne clips it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Mohammad Abbas to bowl from the other end. He was decent in his first spell. Will he break this flourishing partnership? Two slips in place for him.
Floated delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Short on off, Dimuth pulls it to deepish mid-wicket for a run. He will feel that he missed out there.
Slow through the air around off, Karunaratne prods forward to defend but gets it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Shortish on off, punched off the back foot to mid on.
Spinning in from outside off, Dimuth camps back and defends it solidly.
Flatter delivery on middle and leg, worked to square leg for a brisk single.

We are back for the final session. Dimuth Karunaratne and Dinesh Chandimal to continue their innings. An inspiring bowling effort is the need of the hour for Pakistan. Yasir Shah to start off with the ball after Tea. A slip and silly point in place. Here we go...
... Day 1, Session 3 ...

Pakistan have tried out everything but without any success. Yasir Shah has bowled well and if the hosts are to trigger a collapse, he is the man to do it. Hasan Ali has also bent his back, bowling his heart out. Will Sri Lanka continue their good show with the bat or will the home side come back with a bang in the evening session? Join us to find out.

A very good session for Sri Lanka. They have scored 83 runs in 30.5 overs without losing any wicket. Though the track has a bit of variable bounce, it is still good for batting and the visitors are utilizing it well. Karunaratne has been really impressive, continuing his good form from the home series against India. A century is in the offering for him.
Lands it on a length outside off, the batsman does not play at it. THAT IS TEA ON DAY 1!
Sarfraz Ahmed goes to Hasan Ali for a chat with him. A few field changes. First slip goes wide. There is also an extra man in the gully region.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Lands it on a length around off, Karunaratne camps back and defends it.
Good length outside off, Karunaratne defends it off the front foot.
A surprise bouncer there! A very, very good one. Dimuth does well to duck under it.
Comes running in and angles it into the pads, Karunaratne flicks it to the man at square leg.
Shorter in length outside off, this time. Dimuth cuts it through covers for a run.
FOUR! A freebie! Karunaratne won't be missing out on this. Shafiq tosses it up on leg stump. Karunaratne flicks it through mid-wicket and into the boundary.
Very full on middle, Dimuth jams it out to mid-wicket.
Drives the ball on off back to the bowler.
Flatter on middle, straightens with the arm. Karunaratne defends it off the front foot.
Works it with the spin through square leg for a run.
Asad Shafiq comes into the attack. Pakistan trying out everything to pick up a wicket.
Well bowled Hasan Ali! He hurls it on a length around middle and gets it to shape away after pitching. Karunaratne is squared up a touch but defends it off the outer half to the man at gully.
Fuller in length on off, Dimuth lunges forward in defense.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Works it with the angle to mid-wicket.

EDGY FOUR! Not where Karunaratne intended but he won't mind. Fuller in length on off, shapes away a touch. Dimuth tries to force it through the off side but gets an edge through backward point for a boundary.
Lands it on a length around off, Karunaratne defends it off the back foot.
Dinesh uses his feet to the quicker delivery and works it to Amir at mid-wicket. There is a bit of fumble but Chandimal decides against the run.
Slow through the air on off, Chandimal defends it solidly. He needs to watch out for the straighter one. Shah is really good with his variations.
Fullish on middle and leg, turned to mid-wicket.
More revolutions on that delivery, landing around leg stump and spinning sharply. Chandimal prods forward to defend but gets it off the outer half to covers.
Shortish delivery outside off, cut to point.
Flatter delivery outside off, turning in sharply and also staying low. Karunaratne adjusts well to tuck it through backward square leg for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter in length outside off, Chandimal tries to cut but gets a bottom edge which rolls besides the pitch.
Back of a length on off, Dimuth defends it off the back foot towards point and sets off for a run. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but misses. No harm done.
Lucky Karunaratne! Hasan Ali angles it into the batsman. Karunaratne tries to defend it off the back foot but gets an inside edge which goes past the off stump and down to fine leg for a couple.
Good length around off, Karunaratne guides it down to third man, the fielder from gully gives it chase and keeps it down to two.
Yorker outside off, Dimuth jams it out off the toe-end towards the slip fielder.
NO BALL! The first of the day. Hasan lands it on a length on off, Karunaratne defends it off the back foot. He has overstepped there.
Floats it on off, Chandimal defends it off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter on middle, Chandimal flicks it to mid-wicket.
Comes down to the pitch of the ball and drives it towards mid on for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Karunaratne pushes it to the man at covers.

Tosses it up on middle, Chandimal drives it towards mid off and sets off for a run. The fielder is quick to the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Chandimal also puts in a dive and hence even if there was a direct hit, he was safe. Also, according to the new rules even if the bat is in the air inside the crease the batsman is not out if he has grounded the bat before.
Yasir Shah is back into the attack. He has been the best bowler for Pakistan so far. Can he provide the breakthrough?
Fullish ball outside off, Dimuth drives it to the man at covers.
Slower delivery and full in length outside off, Karunaratne lunges forward and blocks it.
Fuller in length this time on off, Karunaratne mistimes his drive to mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, Karunaratne defends it solidly.
Good length outside off, Dimuth opts not to play at it.
Comes around the wicket and lands it on a length outside off. Karunaratne shoulders his arms to it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted ball on off, turning back in. Karunaratne flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Russel Arnold on-air makes a good point. He says that the Pakistanis are easily giving away the singles. They need to apply more pressure.
Eases it down to long on for a run.
Angles it into the batsman, bowls a wrong one. Chandimal works it to mid-wicket.
Works it with the turn down towards short fine leg for a run.
Loopy ball on off, Karunaratne flicks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Smart shot! Hasan Ali bowls a very full ball outside off, Chandimal squeezes it past the diving gully fielder and into the third man fence.
Bowls it on a length on off, Chandimal defends it solidly.
Length ball on off, Dinesh defends it off the back foot.
BOUNCER! The batsman does well to evade it.
Lands it on a length around off. Chandimal defends it off the front foot.
