FOUR! EDGED BUT SHORT! Hasan Ali goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. The ball nips away after pitching. Chandimal feels for it and the ball takes the outside edge, which falls short of the first slip fielder and goes through his hands for a boundary.
Floats it up on off, Karunaratne drives it to the man at covers.
Shorter in length outside off, Dinesh cuts it through point for a run.
Drags his length back on off, turns back in. Karunaratne camps back and pushes it down to long on for a run.
Works it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Tosses it up on off, turning back in. Dimuth drives it to mid on.
Shorter in length around off, Chandimal punches it through the off side for a run. The run also brings up the 50-run stand between the two.
The batsman has driven it towards mid on.
Change in angle for Hasan Ali. He goes around the wicket and bowls it outside off. Karunaratne lets it be.
Back of a length around off, Dimuth defends it off the back foot.

FOUR! That was beautifully timed! You have to time it really well on this outfield if you want a boundary. Hasan bowls it fuller in length on off, Karunaratne flicks it through mid-wicket and the ball races to the fence.
A touch fuller outside off, angling away from the batsman. Karunaratne shoulders his arms to it.
Works it with the angle towards mid-wicket for a run.
Tosses it up outside off, Karunaratne goes after it and slashes hard. He gets an outside edge through short third man for a couple.
Fuller outside off, Chandimal drives it towards cover-point for a run.
Advances down the track seeing the flight on the ball. Karunaratne hits it through mid on for a run.
Dances down the track and drives it down towards long on for a run.
Works it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Tosses it up on off, turning back in. Karunaratne defends it off the front foot.
Fuller in length outside off, inviting Chandimal to drive. He obliges but hits it straight to the man at covers.
Good length on off, Dinesh defends it off the front foot.
Stays low! There has been inconsistent bounce in the wicket. Hasan Ali lands it on a length around off, stays a touch low. Chandimal does well to get his bat down in time.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Back of a length around off, Dinesh covers the line of the ball and defends it.
Starts off on a length on off, Chandimal defends it off the back foot.
Hasan Ali is into the attack, change of ends for him. He has picked up a wicket but has bowled only 5 overs till now.
Fuller ball outside off, Dimuth defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it up on off, Karunaratne defends it watchfully.
Floats it full on middle, Chandimal drives it down to long on this time for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tosses it up on off, Karunaratne drives it down to long off for a run.

Action straightaway! He bowls a loosener down the leg side. Karunaratne tries to flick but it goes off something to Sarfraz who collects it and appeals but the umpire remains put. Replays show that it had gone off the pad, correct decision by the umpire.
Haris Sohail, the debutant comes on to bowl.
Time for Drinks!
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Poor from Hasan Ali! Floats it up on off, Chandimal drives it towards long off where Hasan Ali takes his eye of the ball and lets it through between his legs. Although he does well to recover and pull it back just before the rope. The batsmen get an extra run.
Tosses it up on middle, Dinesh defends it solidly.
A flipper on the stumps, Chandimal does well to defend it.
Goes wide of the crease and bowls a leg break outside off, turning back in. Karunaratne flicks it through square leg for a run.
Lands it on a length around off, Chandimal defends it solidly.
Bangs in a short one on middle. Karunaratne pulls it through square leg for a run.
Shorter in length but down the leg side. Karunaratne ducks under it. Sarfraz does well to run to his right and collect the ball.
Comes around the wicket to the left-hander and bowls it full outside off. Karunaratne drives it to the man at mid off.
Fuller in length on the pads, Chandimal is too good a player to miss out on these. He flicks it through mid-wicket and bags three runs.
Fuller in length on off, Chandimal drives it to mid off.
Fuller in length on middle, Chandimal drives it towards long on and sets off for a run. The fielder gets to the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. A run added.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Tosses it up outside off, turns away. Chandimal knows Yasir Shah does not bowl a lot of googlies and he lets it be.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Drags his length back on off, Dimuth has all the time in the world to rock back and flick it through mid-wicket for a run.
Bowls it from around the wicket angle. Tosses it up outside off, turning back in. Karunaratne defends it solidly.
Shorter in length outside off, Chandimal goes after it but cuts it to the man at point.
Fuller in length outside off, Chandimal does not fiddle with it.
Good length outside off, Chandimal lets it be.
Driven towards the mid off region.

Confusion but no harm done! Abbas bowls it full on middle, Chandimal flicks it towards square leg. Karunaratne wanted a run but was sent back by his partner seeing that the fielder was quick to the ball.

Fifty for Karunaratne, his 13th Test fifty. A really important one. A much-needed one for his team but he needs to carry on. Abbas angles it into the batsman on a length. Dimuth flicks it towards mid on and takes a quick single.
Flatter on off, turns away. Chandimal tries to defend but it goes off the outer half towards backward point for a couple.
Slower through the air on middle, Karunaratne flicks it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Dimuth charges down the track to cover the spin, does well and gets to the pitch of the ball. He works it to the man at mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Comes around the wicket and tosses it up outside off, turns into the batsman. Karunaratne tries to paddle sweep it with the angle but misses as the ball turns past the leg stump. That really spun a lot.
Works it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Flicks it with the angle down to fine leg for a run.

BEATEN! Lovely stuff from Abbas! He bowls it fuller outside off, Karunaratne goes after it and plays a loose shot away from his body to get beaten. There are two slips waiting for an edge. Needless shot from the southpaw.
Fuller in length on off, wanting Dimuth to drive. He obliges but hits it straight back to the bowler.
Back of a length on middle. Karunaratne tries to hit it through mid-wicket but gets an inside edge onto his thigh pad.
Comes around the wicket and bowls it full, also gets it to shape back in. Dimuth flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, Karunaratne guides it to the man at point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floats it on middle, turns away. Chandimal tries to flick but gets a soft leading edge back to the bowler.
BEAUTY! Yasir is getting the ball to rip here. He bowls it slower through the air on off. Drifts into the batsman and then turns away sharply. Chandimal tries to defend it but gets beaten.
Shorter and quicker outside off, Chandimal goes for the cut shot but is beaten by the low bounce. Ahmed behind the stumps does well to collect it.
A leg spinner on off, turning away ever so slightly. Chandimal lunges forward to cover the spin and blocks it.
Loopy ball on off, does not turn a lot. Chandimal lunges forward and blocks it.
Again bowls it on a length outside off, hoping for an edge but Karunaratne is solid in defense.
Lands it on a length around off, angling away from the batsman. Karunaratne defends it off the front foot.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
FOUR! Karunaratne was waiting for this delivery! Abbas bowls it short and wide outside off. Karunaratne seeing the width on offer goes after it and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Full and very wide outside off. Karunaratne shoulders his arms to it.
Back of a length outside off, Karunaratne punches it off the back foot to the man at covers.
Mohammad Abbas is brought back into the attack. He bowled a tight first spell. Sarfraz would want him to continue the same.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Gives it air and lands it outside off, turning back in. Karunaratne flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Bowls it quicker on leg stump. Chandimal flicks it fine down the leg side for three.
Drags his length back on middle, Dinesh has all the time in the world to rock onto the back foot and hit it towards mid on.
Slower through the air outside off. Chandimal opts not to play at it.
Flatter delivery on middle, Chandimal defends it off the front foot.
A yorker on middle, Karunaratne does really well to get his bat down in time and jam it to mid-wicket.
An off cutter outside off, Chandimal plants his front foot forward and pushes it towards cover-point for a run.
Bowls it wide outside off, inviting the batsman to drive. Chandimal opts not to and lets it through to the keeper.
Fuller in length on off, Dinesh drives it to the man at covers.
Back of a length on off, Chandimal defends it off the back foot.
Shorter in length, comes slower off the wicket after pitching. Karunaratne pulls it uppishly but well short of the man at deep square leg for a run.
Mistimes his reverse sweep past the diving slip fielder and the batsmen run three.
Drags his length back on middle, skids off the surface. Dinesh goes on the back foot and works it past the diving short mid-wicket fielder and towards wide mid on for a run.
Slower through the air outside off, Dinesh eases it to the man at covers.
Flipper on off, Chandimal reads it well and defends it stoutly.
Tosses it up on off, Chandimal prods forward and defends it.
Flatter on off, turns away from the batsman. Chandimal does well to let it spin and guide it towards point.
Lands it on a length around middle, Karunaratne with the angle plays it to mid-wicket.
Slower delivery outside off, Karunaratne plays it towards point. They think about a run but then opts not to.
A tad shorter in length outside off, Karunaratne gets into position and cuts it through covers for a couple.
Comes over the wicket and lands it on a length on middle. Chandimal defends it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Shorter one and this time Karunaratne takes on the challenge of pulling it. He hits it towards deep square leg for a run.
Amir comes steaming in and lands it on a length on off, Karunaratne with all the time in the world defends it towards covers.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Fuller in length on off, Chandimal drives it to the man at mid off.
Shah gives it air on off, Dinesh drives it to mid off.
A leg spinner which skids off the surface. Chandimal does well to defend it.
Quicker delivery on leg stump, Chandimal with the angle works it to mid-wicket.
Tosses it up outside off, Chandimal drives it to mid off.
Back of a length around off, Chandimal pushes it towards covers for a run.
Bowls it from behind the crease, from 24 yards. Lands it on a length. Chandimal punches it to mid off.
Comes around the wicket and lands it on a length outside off. Chandimal does not fiddle with it.
Good length around off, angling away. Chandimal confidently punches it to the man at mid off.
Shorter in length outside off, Chandimal need not play at it.
Good length on off, Karunaratne punches it down towards long on and sets off for a run. Abbas there runs to his right and makes a good diving stop but could not prevent the single.
Quicker on middle, Chandimal defends it watchfully.
Fuller delivery on middle, Dinesh drives it to mid on.
Flighted ball on off, goes on with the arm. Chandimal tries to drive it through the off side but mistimes it to mid on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter delivery, flipper on middle. Chandimal defends it off the front foot.
Gives it air on off, Karunaratne plays it down to long on with the spin for a run.

Variation from Amir. He bowls a slower ball, full on middle. Karunaratne works it towards mid on and sets off for a run. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. A single added. It was a risky run.
Back of a length on off, bounces a touch more. Dimuth tries to push it through the off side but gets it off the inner half to mid on.
Amir is making good use of the crease here. He now goes wide of it and angles it on off. Karunaratne defends it solidly.
Bangs in a short ball on off, Dimuth ducks under it. The umpire signals one for the over.
Angles it on the pads of Dimuth who flicks it to mid-wicket.
Lands it on a length on off, Karunaratne who looked solid before the break defends it off the front foot.
Mohammad Amir will bowl from the other end.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

This one turns sharply! He bowls it slower through the air outside leg, turns away from the batsman. Chandimal tries to flick but misses and is struck on the pads. There is a muted appeal but nothing from the umpire. It may have gone on to hit the stumps but was pitching outside leg.
Flighted ball on middle, does not turn a lot. Dinesh defends it off the front foot.
Floats it up on middle, Chandimal defends it solidly.
Starts off with a flatter but shorter delivery on middle, a flipper you can say. Chandimal works it to the man at short leg.

We're all set to resume. The men who matter are out in the middle. Dinesh Chandimal, their skipper is the new man in. Dimuth Karunaratne will continue from where he left off. Yasir Shah to continue his over.
...Day 1, Session 2...

The away side would now hope their captain Chandimal and Karunaratne, who is batting well out there can stitch a good partnership together and bail them out of trouble. The hosts, on the other hand, would hope for more wickets to stay on top. Join us in a while for the second session.

So, Pakistan enter the break in cruise control. Sri Lanka, after winning the toss won't be happy with how things have panned out. They started the first hour really well without losing a wicket but after the drinks break, it went all wrong. Pakistan made it difficult for them to score and it resulted in Sri Lankan batsmen making more mistakes and losing their wickets.

OUT! Just at the stroke of lunch, Yasir Shah strikes and it is an absolute gem to get rid of Kusal Mendis. Yasir goes wide of the crease and tosses it up on off, he gets it to drift into the batsman before turning it away. Mendis lunges forward in defense but gets an outside edge to Sarfraz, who grabs it on the second attempt and appeals. The umpire has no doubt as he raises his finger. A big, big wicket here for Pakistan. Yasir once again is the man who is waving his magic. He gets his second and there are smiles on the faces of the hosts. Sri Lanka in trouble here as they head into LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Lands it on a length around middle, Karunaratne drives it back to mid on.
A good effort by the fielder there! Fuller in length by Masood, Karunaratne drives it towards mid on, who dives to his right and makes a good stop.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Fuller in length around off. Karunaratne drives it to mid off.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Starts off with a full toss outside off. Karunaratne drives it to the man at covers.
Surprise, surprise! Shan Masood is into the attack just before lunch.
Quicker outside off, Mendis first thinks about cutting it but then lets it go.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Very full ball on leg stump, almost a yorker by the spinner. Mendis does well to flick it to mid on.
Gives it air and bowls it fuller on off. Mendis defends it off the front foot.
That was nicely played by Mendis! He waits for the ball to turn away and then delicately guides it through backward point for a couple.
Shorter in length on middle, Dimuth lets it turn and works it through backward square leg for a run.
Comes around the wicket and lands it on a length around off. Mendis defends it off the front foot.
Works it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.
He is putting in a lot of effort here! He bangs in another short one on a wicket which is very slow. That was just a little shorter than the last one. Karunaratne lets it through easily.
A sharp bouncer by Amir. Karunaratne ducks under it.
Back of a length outside off, jags back in a touch. Dimuth pushes it back to the bowler.
Good length on off, Karunaratne defends it off the front foot.

Loopy ball on off, Mendis drives it towards mid off and completes a run. The fielder scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. The ball deflects past the fielder who was backing up and they get another overthrow.
Flatter on off stump, Mendis watchfully keeps it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Gives it air on middle, Mendis prods forward in defense.
Tosses it up on middle, Karunaratne lets it turn and then works it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen complete a run. The fielder fumbles but does not concede an extra run.
Works it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Just behind a length around off. Dimuth pushes it through covers for a run.

FOUR! He finally puts one away! Bangs it short outside off. Karunaratne cuts it through backward point and into the boundary. Poor length and line by Amir, he is offering a lot of room to the batsman. This also brings up the fifty for Sri Lanka.
Karunaratne misses out there! Amir bowls it short and wide outside off. Karunaratne cuts it hard but straight to Yasir Shah at point. Dimuth should have put that away.
Fuller in length on off, Karunaratne eases it to the man at mid off.
Shorter in length outside off, Dimuth cuts it but straight to the man at point.
Back of a length on off, Karunaratne defends it off the back foot.
Mohammad Amir is back into the attack, also change of ends for him. He was a touch wayward in his first spell, will he get his line right?
Works it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.

That kept low! Yasir almost had another. He bowls it flatter on middle, turns back in and keeps low. Karunaratne misses the flick and is struck on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire shakes his head. That might be missing leg but a close call there.
Bowls a leg spinner on middle, turns away ever so slightly. Mendis tries to defend it but the ball takes the outside edge and goes towards point for a run.
Floats it full on middle. Mendis drives it to covers.
Gives it air this time on off, Mendis mistimes his drive back to the bowler.
Tosses it up outside off, turning away. Mendis opts not to play at it.
Back of a length outside off, Karunaratne punches it to the man at covers off the back foot.
FOUR LEG BYES! Errs in line, Hasan. He angles it down the leg side. Karunaratne misses the flick and it goes off the pads, beating the diving keeper and down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Good length on off, Karunaratne defends it solidly.
That was nicely timed! Fuller in length on off. Mendis leans into it and pushes it through mid off. Aslam, there gives it a chase and does well to pull it in. He saves a run for his team.
Good length outside off, Mendis guides it to the man at point.
Back of a length on middle, Karunaratne taps it towards mid on for a run.
Mendis is off the mark! Shorter in length outside off, Kusal rocks back and cuts it through the cover region for a couple.
Fuller on off, Kusal eases it to covers.
Quicker on off, Mendis lunges forward in defense.
Flatter on off, Mendis solidly defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it up on off, Mendis defends it off the front foot.
Shah gives it air on middle. Karunaratne comes down the track seeing the flight and works it uppishly but wide of the man at short leg for a run.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Good length outside off. Mendis is a touch vulnerable on that line but this time he lets it through.
Flicks it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length on off, Karunaratne defends it off the back foot.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
Fuller in length on off, Karunaratne drives it back to the bowler.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Kusal Mendis strides out to the middle. He is one of Sri Lanka's best batsmen and they would want him to fire. Also a new position for him, no.4, he usually comes out to bat at no.3.

OUT! What was Thirimanne thinking there? He had just arrived to the crease and he plays a big slog. Yasir Shah, smartly gives it air on middle and bowls it full. Lahiru could not resist as he goes down on one knee and tries to heave it over mid-wicket but misses and is struck on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire straightaway raises his finger. That was plumb. A poor shot to be honest. Yasir Shah is ecstatic. He has 150 Test wickets now, the quickest spinner to do so. Sri Lanka have lost two in two overs and are in a spot of bother now.
Slower through the air on middle, Thirimanne goes back and across and times his push to mid on.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter on off, Thirimanne defends it off the back foot.
Shorter in length on middle, turns back in. Karunaratne waits for it to turn and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flicks it with the angle towards mid-wicket.
Comes around the wicket and angles it full on the pads. Thirimanne flicks it to mid-wicket.
Lahiru Thirimanne is the next man in.

OUT! KABOOM! Hasan Ali draws first blood! Silva who was looking a touch tentative at the balls bowled outside off, drags it on. Ali hurls it on a length outside off. Kaushal first thinks about playing at it but then opts to leave it. The ball gets a touch big on him and also skids off the surface, takes the inside edge and crashes onto the stumps. Hasan Ali does provide the breakthrough for Pakistan.
Bouncer! Silva does well to duck under it.

Fuller in length on off, Silva drives it back to the bowler, who bends and makes a good stop in his followthrough. He shows good awareness by having a shy at the non-striker's end to check whether he is alert but misses the stumps.
Tosses it up on middle. Karunaratne defends it solidly.
Drags his length back outside off. Silva waits for it to turn and guides it to cover-point for a run.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.

TURN! BOUNCE! This ball had everything. Brilliant by Yasir Shah. Floats it on off, it turns away sharply and also bounces, Silva tries to defend but gets beaten. The keeper collects it at chest height.
Works it towards square leg with the spin for a run.
Quicker on middle, turning back in. Karunaratne dances down the track and misses the flick as he is struck on the pads. There is an ambitious appeal from the players but the umpire remains put.
LOVELY STUFF! That was nicely bowled. Hasan Ali makes good use of the crease and goes wide of it. He angles it in and gets it to shape away. Silva pokes at it but gets beaten.
Length outside off, gets it to bounce a touch more. Silva opts not to play at it.
Good length on middle, Silva who has looked solid up till now. Defends it off the front foot.
These two share good chemistry between them. Hasan Ali bowls it on a length around middle. Dimuth flicks it towards square leg. The fielder makes a good diving stop but could not prevent a run.
Comes around the wicket and angles it into the batsman. Karunaratne flicks it to mid-wicket.
Good length around off, Karunaratne tries to defend but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket. He thinks about a run but then is sent back by his partner as the fielder was quick to the ball.

Drinks! Sri Lanka have done well. They have not lost a wicket in the first hour. The pitch seems a touch slow and difficult for scoring runs. The Pakistan bowlers have not got a lot of assistance from the wicket and they will desperately want a breakthrough.
Flighted ball outside off, turning back in. Karunaratne flicks it through the leg side for a run.
Dimuth dances down the track. Yasir Shah sees him coming down and drags his length back. Karunaratne adjusts and defends it well.
Floats it on off, Dimuth defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Works it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Flatter but down the leg side, Karunaratne fails to flick it and the keeper collects it.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Lands it on a length around off. Silva lets it be.

EDGY FOUR! The first of the day, not how he intended but Kaushal won't mind. Hasan Ali bowls it around off, shapes away after pitching. Silva pokes at it and gets an outside edge through the slip cordon for a boundary. He goes past 2000 runs in Test cricket.
Good length outside off stump. Silva like he has been doing up till now, leaves it watchfully.
Starts off with a length ball outside off, stays a touch low. Silva showing patience, opts not to play at it.
Hasan Ali is into the attack. A slippery kind of a bowler. Can he provide the breakthrough?
Fuller in length outside off, Dimuth drives it to mid off.
Loopy ball outside off, turns back in. Karunaratne being a good player of spin, defends it solidly.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Drags his length back on the stumps. Karunaratne pushes it off the back foot to the man at covers.
Flatter this time on middle, Dimuth works it to mid-wicket.
Flighted ball on middle, turning into the batsman. Karunaratne flicks it with the spin through mid-wicket for a brace.
Shorter in length outside off. Seeing the width Silva's eyes lit up there. He went after it but gets beaten. Almost an edge there, a good over by Abbas.

Almost a drag on! Abbas continues to bowl it in that channel outside off. This time closer to the off pole. Silva is not sure whether to play at it or not. He hangs his bat out and gets an inside edge which bounces over the stumps. That was close.
Shorter in length on middle, not a lot of pace off the wicket. Silva quite easily ducks under it.
Abbas I think is finding it difficult to adjust with the left hand, right hand combination. He bowls it full on the pads, Silva flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Angles it into the pads, Dimuth flicks it through mid-wicket. He completes a run, thinks about the second but then opts against it. A good decision, there was never two there.
Length ball outside off, Karunaratne lets it through.
Flatter on off, Silva defends it off the front foot. A tight over from Yasir.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tosses it up outside off, Silva eases it to covers.
Fires it on off, gets it to turn away. Silva pushes it towards cover-point off the back foot.
Dimuth uses his feet and takes the ball on the full. He drives it towards mid on for a run.
Flatter on middle, Karunaratne defends it off the back foot.

Yasir Shah, the leg spinner comes into the attack. Interestingly, Pakistan have only one specialist spinner in their line-up, whereas Sri Lanka have gone with atleast two in the form of Herath and Sandakan.
Back of a length on off, Silva taps it towards cover and sets off for a run. Karunaratne at the other end sees the fielder get to the ball quickly and refuses the run. No harm done.
Good length gets it to come into the batsman this time. Silva watchfully leaves it.
Good length around off, pitches and moves away. Kaushal gets it off the outer half and on the bounce to gully.
Flicks it with the angle past the diving mid-wicket fielder and collects a brace.
Abbas comes around the wicket but angles it into the pads. Karunaratne flicks it through backward square leg. Amir from fine leg runs to his right and keeps it down to two.
Full and outside off, inviting the batsman to drive. He obliges but gets it off the inner half due to the slowness of the wicket to mid off.
Lands it on a length outside off, stays a touch low. Silva opts not to play at it. It seems to be a very slow surface also the outfield is not that fast. Run scoring won't be easy.
Lands it on a length around middle, not a lot of pace off the surface. Silva defends it solidly.
Fuller in length on middle, trying to get some swing but there is none available. Dimuth flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Good batting by Sri Lanka! Amir bowls it on a length around off, Silva taps it towards covers and takes a quick single.
Better delivery! He gets it closer to off, also shapes in a touch. Silva keeps his eye on the ball and lets it through. A good leave in the end you can say.
Good length outside off, from around the wicket. Silva lets it through to the keeper.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

A huge appeal! Abbas bowls it on a length around leg stump, gets it to jag back in sharply. Karunaratne fails to flick but misses and is struck on the pads. The Pakistani players appeal but the umpire stays put. Might be missing leg.
Fuller on the pads but this time, Karunaratne flicks it straight to mid-wicket. He will be disappointed he did not put that away.
Bowls it on a length around middle. Karunaratne who is very good at using his writs, flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller in length outside off, Dimuth shoulders his arms to it.
Sarfraz Ahmed has a word with Abbas. Maybe, he wants the bowler to make the batsman play a little more.
Abbas continues to bowl it a tad outside off. Karunaratne need not play at it.
Change in angle almost pays dividends there! Amir comes around the wicket and angles it into the batsman, gets it to shape away. Silva feels for it but gets beaten. A beauty to finish by Amir.
Again hits that good length area on off. Silva is solid in defense.
Good length ball, lands it on middle, wanting Silva to fall over as he tries to play across but he defends it with a straight bat.
First signs of aggression by Amir. He comes running in and bangs it in short on middle. Kaushal watches it early and ducks under it.
Good length outside off, Silva shoulders his arms to it.
Seam up delivery from Amir but no swing on offer. Bowls it on middle. Karunaratne flicks it towards mid-wicket and changes strike.
Good length outside off, Silva does not play at it.

Bowls it a touch straighter this time. Silva flicks it straight to short leg who shows good awareness, collects the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. There was no danger there for the batsman but good work from the fielder.
Good length outside off, Kaushal need not play at it.
Again bowls it wide outside off, not making the batsman play too often. Silva shoulders his arms to it.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.

Close! Abbas bowls it on a length around off. Karunaratne defends it towards mid off and sets off for a run. The fielder there is quick to the ball and throws it at the non-striker's end but misses. No harm done in the end.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Scratch what I wrote. He bowls a beauty this time. Amir lands it on a length around off, gets it to go away with the angle. Silva tries to defend but gets beaten.
Amir is not quite getting it right! He bowls it down the leg side, Silva fails to flick it and it goes off the pads down to fine leg for two leg byes.
Good length outside off, angling away from the batsman. Silva points his bat skywards and lets it through.
A scrambled seam delivery on off, Silva defends it stoutly.
Again Amir errs in line and sprays it on the pads. Karunaratne tries to flick but misses. The ball hits the pads and rolls towards the leg side for a leg bye.
Back of a length on off, Karunaratne taps it in front of covers for a run.

Good length on off, gets outward movement after pitching. Silva pokes at it and gets an outside edge through the slip cordon. The outfield here is quite slow and also the boundaries are quite big and hence it does not go all the way. The batsman run three.
Makes the batsman play this time. He lands it on a length around off. Gets it to shape away after pitching. Silva defends it solidly.
Once again, bowls it on the length just outside off, perfect Test match length. Silva watchfully lets it through.
Fuller in length on middle, Silva drives it to mid on.
Fuller in length outside off, swinging away, wanting the batsman to drive. Kaushal resists the temptation and opts not to play at it.
Comes around the wicket as there is minimal movement and angles it into the batsman. Silva works it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Errs in line Amir. Drifts it on the pads. Silva flicks it fine down towards fine leg. Abbas hares to his right, bends down and does well to keep it down to two.
Flicks it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.

BEATEN! Beauty by Amir! He comes steaming in and goes wide of the crease. Angles it into the batsman and gets it to straighten. Karunaratne tries to defend it but gets beaten. That could have so easily taken the edge. There are three slips waiting.
Amir comes running in and lands it on a length on off, Karunaratne defends it solidly.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Just to let everybody know, Umpire Richard Kettleborough replaces Ian Gould who is not feeling well. Ahsan Raza is the third umpire for today at least.
Good length ball on off, Silva defends it off the front foot.
Lands it on a length outside off, inviting the batsman to go after it. Silva resists the temptation and lets it through.
Bowls it in the corridor of uncertainty. Silva keeps his eye on the ball and leaves it.
Length ball outside off. Silva lets it be.
Swing on offer for the bowler. He bowls it full outside off. Silva who is making a return into the team watchfully lets it through to the keeper.
Starts off on the money but fuller in length on middle. Dimuth flicks it towards mid on. The fielder there makes a half stop and concedes a run.
Mohammad Abbas will bowl from the other end. He too has three slips and gully in place for him.

Finishes the over with a nice delivery. Amir goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. It shapes away after pitching. Karunaratne tries to flick but gets a soft leading edge through cover-point for a run. Sri Lanka are underway.
Lands it on a length outside off, Dimuth opts not to play at it.
Amir not quite at full pace up till now. Bowls a length ball on off, Karunaratne lunges forward in defense.
Fuller in length on middle. The batsman drives it to mid on.
Amir does get some away movement this time. Bowls it a tad fuller on middle, shapes away a little. Karunaratne tries to defend but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Starts off with a loosener down the leg side. Karunaratne fails to flick it and it goes to the keeper. Amir bowls it full in hope of some swing but there was none there.

The players and the umpires walk out to the middle. A new opening pair for Sri Lanka. Dimuth Karunaratne has a new partner in Kaushal Silva. Mohammad Amir will bowl with the new ball, he has three slips and a gully in place.

TOSS - Sri Lanka win the toss and opt to bat first! Kaushal Silva comes in for Sri Lanka, also Suranga Lakmal and Dinesh Chandimal make a return into the team. Haris Sohail wins his first Test cap for Pakistan.

Hello and welcome to Day 1 of the first Test between Pakistan and Sri Lanka at the Sheikh Zayed Stadium in Abu Dhabi. The home side enters into a new phase with Sarfraz Ahmed all set to captain his first game as permanent Test skipper. A lot of new faces have been named in the squad and it will be interesting to see what combination they go with. However, for the away side, we will have to wait and watch whether it has recovered after the drubbing it received against the Indians last month. Dinesh Chandimal would hope to start the day off well as it would increase their confidence. A good contest between bat and ball is what awaits us. Stay tuned for the all important toss in a while.
